classes.name: struct commit_name
classes.description: Represents a commit's naming information, including head name and generation.

methods.name: interesting
methods.description: Returns the first interesting commit from a list, skipping uninteresting ones.

methods.name: commit_to_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name info associated with a commit.

methods.name: name_commit
methods.description: Assigns a name to a commit as the nth generation ancestor of a head.

methods.name: name_parent
methods.description: Names the parent of a commit based on the commit's name.

methods.name: name_first_parent_chain
methods.description: Names the chain of first-parent ancestors starting from a commit.

methods.name: name_commits
methods.description: Assigns names to a list of commits based on provided references.

methods.name: mark_seen
methods.description: Marks a commit as seen if it hasn't been marked already.

methods.name: join_revs
methods.description: Joins revision lists, marking commits as interesting or uninteresting.

methods.name: show_merge_base
methods.description: Displays merge base commits among a list of commits.

methods.name: show_independent
methods.description: Displays commits that are independent (reachable from only one tip).

methods.name: append_ref
methods.description: Adds a reference name and associated commit to the list of refs.

methods.name: append_head_ref
methods.description: Appends a local branch reference to the list.

methods.name: append_remote_ref
methods.description: Appends a remote branch reference to the list.

methods.name: append_tag_ref
methods.description: Appends a tag reference to the list.

methods.name: append_matching_ref
methods.description: Appends references matching a pattern.

methods.name: snarf_refs
methods.description: Fetches references for heads and remotes.

methods.name: rev_is_head
methods.description: Checks if a given ref name matches the current HEAD.
